note: [F] Deicyde/diophantine-z-q, proved: The specialization (program input fixed to the wrapper code, X_1 to X_5, X_i to X_{i+7}, pairing variables X_5..X_8, four appended squared Cantor equations) and its natural-zero characterization are stated, and (C.4) is natural_polynomial_semantics' with no height, restricted-converse or rational-model hypothesis, all proved. Lean builds the polynomial from the circuit; its identity with the saved file is outside Lean, and the remark on the height expression is commentary.

theorem specialize_natRel_iff (H : NatCircuit) (code : ℕ) (T : ExPoly)
    (hH : ∃ rest, H.nodes = .var 0 :: .var 1 :: rest) (hroot : H.root < H.nodes.length)
    (hcall : ∀ a b c w, NatNode.call a b c w ∈ H.nodes → 2 ≤ w) (hV : 2 ≤ H.varCount)
    (c : Fin 5 → ℕ) :
    (specialize H code).NatRel T c ↔
      ∃ y : ℕ → ℕ, y 0 = code ∧ y 1 = CantorDecoder.encode5 (c 0) (c 1) (c 2) (c 3) (c 4) ∧
        (∀ i, H.varCount ≤ i → y i = 0) ∧ zv y (H.poly T) = 0 := by
